blocks.prompt: 6 The braking distance (in metres) of a car is modeled by \(d(s) = 0.02s^2 + 0.1s\), where \(s\) is the speed of car in km/h. If the maximum safe braking distance is 50 metres, find the range of speed where braking is safe.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh word problem hai jo quadratic inequality (barabar nahi, balki "kam ya barabar" wala muqabla) ban jata hai.
Diya kya hai? Car ka braking distance (brake lagane ke baad rukne tak ka faasla) \(d(s) = 0.02s^2 + 0.1s\) metre, aur zyada se zyada mehfooz faasla 50 metre.
Find kya karna hai? Speed ki woh range jis mein braking mehfooz hai.
Plan: \(d(s) \leq 50\) likhna, decimals hatana, critical numbers nikalna, sahi region chunna aur \(s \geq 0\) lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(d(s) = 0.02s^2 + 0.1s\) metre; braking mehfooz jab \(d(s) \leq 50\).
Humein find karna hai: mehfooz speeds \(s\) ki range (km/h mein, \(s \geq 0\)).
Tareeqa: "Maximum safe distance 50 m" ka matlab hai faasla 50 ya us se kam, yani \(\leq\). Quadratic inequality ka tareeqa: pehle dekhein quadratic kahan zero hoti hai (critical numbers), phir dekhein in ke darmiyan aur bahar sign kya hai.

Inequality likhein
\[0.02s^2 + 0.1s \leq 50\]
Kyun: Jab tak rukne ka faasla 50 m se zyada na ho, braking mehfooz hai.

Decimals hatayen
\[s^2 + 5s \leq 2500\]
\[s^2 + 5s - 2500 \leq 0\]
Kyun: 50 se multiply kiya: \(0.02 \times 50 = 1\), \(0.1 \times 50 = 5\), \(50 \times 50 = 2500\). Positive number se multiply karne par inequality ka nishan nahi badalta. Phir 2500 left le aaye taake right par zero ho.
Dhyan dein: negative number se multiply ya divide karein to nishan ulta karna parta hai; yahan 50 positive hai, is liye nahi.

Critical numbers nikalein
\[s = \dfrac{-5 \pm \sqrt{25 + 10000}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{-5 \pm 5\sqrt{401}}{2}\]
\[s \approx 47.56 \text{ or } s \approx -52.56\]
Kyun: \(a = 1, b = 5, c = -2500\) ke saath quadratic formula. Factorization se poore number nahi milte, is liye formula. \(\sqrt{10025} = \sqrt{25 \times 401} = 5\sqrt{401} \approx 100.12\).

Sahi region chunein
\[-52.56 \leq s \leq 47.56\]
\[0 \leq s \leq 47.56\]
Kyun: \(s^2\) ka coefficient positive hai, to parabola upar ko khulti hai (U shakal); roots ke darmiyan graph x-axis ke neeche hota hai, yani expression \(\leq 0\). Speed negative nahi hoti, is liye range 0 se shuru ki.

Tasdeeq
\[s = 40:\ d = 32 + 4 = 36 \leq 50 \;\checkmark\]
\[s = 50:\ d = 50 + 5 = 55 > 50\]
Kyun: 40 km/h (range ke andar) par faasla 36 m, mehfooz. 50 km/h (range se bahar) par 55 m, jo 50 se zyada hai, mehfooz nahi. Natija bilkul theek hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key "\(0 \leq s \leq 4756\) km/h" likhti hai. Is mein decimal point reh gaya hai: upper limit \(s^2 + 5s - 2500 = 0\) ka root hai, jo \(s \approx 47.56\) hai. Sahi jawab \(0 \leq s \leq 47.56\) km/h hai. Socheiye: 4756 km/h to hawai jahaz se bhi kai guna tez hai, car ke liye mumkin hi nahi.
